properties.project_name: Mission Bay Commons P13: Community Garden and SPARK Social SF
properties.digitized_from: OpenStreetMap way 446183018 (leisure=park, name=Parklab) outer edge, cut at DataSF's official centerlines of Merrimac St and 4th St, plus and minus 6.8 m (4th St's roadway is excluded; the Merrimac St line falls about 2-3 m inside P13's community garden beds) into OCII's parcels P12, P13 and P15 (OCII Nov 14, 2024 update, PDF p.17)
properties.accuracy_caveat: The shape is approximate but its outer edge is real. The outer edge is OpenStreetMap way 446183018 (leisure=park, name 'Parklab', community-surveyed). The lines between the three parcels are not surveyed parcel lines: they are drawn at DataSF's official street centerlines for Merrimac St and 4th St, which are roadways across the strip, offset 6.8 m each side (checked on satellite imagery; at Merrimac St the paved crossing is only about 10-11 m wide with the centerline near its east edge, so the line on the P13 side falls about 2-3 m inside the community garden beds, leaving about 70-100 sq m of them out of P13), and the order of the parcels, P12 then P13 then P15 from west to east, is from OCII's November 14, 2024 update (PDF p.17), whose drawing is not to scale. This parcel is the middle one, between Merrimac St and 4th St, about 4,480 sq m. The shape is not clipped to the street layer (street_clip_exempt): clipping a drawn outline against DataSF centerline buffers would cut P12 in two along DataSF's Long Bridge St segment, which crosses the soccer field where imagery shows no roadway, and would trim the north edges of P12 and P15, so the processed shape is the drawn one. This parcel has no Assessor lot of its own: Assessor lot 8710003 (17,562 sq m, active) holds about 68% of this parcel (and this parcel is only about 17% of that lot); the rest of the parcel is on no lot that matches it, so none of them is this parcel's own. The interim uses here are as OCII labels them (OCII's legend label "Community Garden & SPARK Social SF"); they are interim pending the Mission Bay Future Parks Project, which is planned to redesign parcels P12, P13 and P15 into a permanent park (expected dates differ by source; see the record page).

properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-10-24: split out of data/manual/mission_bay_commons_interim_west.geojson, whose single polygon covered all of P12, P13 and P15 (that file's digitization_method holds the full earlier history: added 2026-09-18 from OSM way 446183018, accuracy audits of 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-12, renamed 2026-10-17, and this split on 2026-10-24). Method: the old outline (OSM way 446183018, about 14,655 sq m, 420 m long on its long axis) was cut at the two cross streets that are real roadways across the strip. DataSF official centerline segments Merrimac St (CNN 15008000, Mission Bay Blvd North to South) and 4th St (CNN 19985000) cross the strip at right angles about 68 m west and 79 m east of its centre; each was buffered 6.8 m either side (src/street_geometry.py's half-width) and that band removed from the outline, leaving three polygons whose outer vertices are OSM's own. Satellite imagery (Esri World Imagery, zoom 20, read by eye and with src/satellite_check.py's tile fetch) shows both as marked roadways with crosswalks, so cutting there is right in kind; how well the band fits differs. At 4th St the cut lines fall close to the crosswalk edges. At Merrimac St the paved crossing is only about 10-11 m wide and the centerline runs near its east edge, so the band's east side falls about 2-3 m inside P13's community garden beds (about 70-100 sq m of garden beds left out of P13) while its west side falls close to the paved edge; the cut was kept at the centerline plus 6.8 m rather than hand-moved, so that every line follows the same rule. The DataSF Long Bridge St centerline segment (CNN 15004000) also crosses the strip, about 19 m east of the OSM outline's west end, but the imagery shows the soccer field there and no roadway, so the strip was not cut at it and P12's west end stays as OSM has it, at the street west of the field. P15's east end stays as OSM has it: it is about 10.6 m from the centerline of 3rd St (CNN 185203) and about 3-4 m (a sidewalk width) from that street's west curb, which agrees with OCII's drawing placing 3rd St between P15 and P16 (the drawing is axonometric and not to scale, so it fixes the order of parcels and streets, not distances). Because the shape is geometry_type approximate, src/join_approximate.py would clip it against street-centerline buffers; street_clip_exempt is set so the processed shape is the drawn one (the clip would cut P12 in two along the Long Bridge St segment and trim the north edges of P12 and P15). Assessor check (data/raw/parcels.geojson, by location): lots 8710003, 8732001 and 8711005 overlap the strip; none matches any parcel at 85% both ways (details in accuracy_caveat), so no lot is used (CLAUDE.md, 'An official parcel beats our drawing', applies only to a lot that is the record's own). Source of the parcel order and names: OCII, 'Remaining Mission Bay Open Space Parcels Update', Nov 14, 2024, PDF p.17 legend 'P12 SFF Soccer + Fitness Court', 'P13 Community Garden & SPARK Social SF', 'P15 Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens' with a drawing placing P12 between Long Bridge St and Merrimac St, P13 between Merrimac St and 4th St and P15 between 4th St and 3rd St; p.5 shows P12-P15 as one strip west of P16-P17. 2026-10-25 -- review corrections (text and flag only; no change to the shape): added street_clip_exempt: true (see accuracy_caveat). The 2026-10-24 entry had said the Merrimac St and 4th St cuts 'sit on the visible curbs' and that P15's east end was 'about 10 m short of the west curb of 3rd St'. Both were wrong: at Merrimac St the cut is the centerline plus 6.8 m and falls about 2-3 m inside P13's community garden beds (about 70-100 sq m left out), and P15's east end is about 10.6 m from 3rd St's centerline (CNN 185203) and 3-4 m from its west curb. The text above now says so.
